caption:
Figure 1: Illustrative examples of ontology-harnessed reasoning in OHM. In knowledge graph (KG)
completion (left), type knowledge helps identify the missing entity. In anomaly detection (right),
relation-domain knowledge reveals that Lived in is incompatible with Tesla as a company. The
ontology provides supporting evidence rather than a hard decision rule.
